Step 3 appended nothing because I thought nothing was deferred. That was wrong for these two lines, so I append now and fix the status header to match. No question needs asking first. The marker rules let me write `→ item:` on my own, and I will not write `→ dropped:` without your word.

First check, since the environment reports no git repo here:

<command>git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree</command>

If that fails, I use plain `mv` below and skip the commit.

## 12-station-upload-retry — 2026-10-30

      station/upload.py and the gateway receiver. Size: plan. Done when:
      station uploads are compressed, the gateway decompresses them under its
      own tests, and both ship before the winter deployment.
- [ ] Fallback buffer size (plan 12, Task 2): the SD-card fallback buffer
      stays at 64 MB; no station has reported `BUFFER_FULL` in the last year
      of logs. See specs/plans/completed/12-station-upload-retry.md; touches
      station/upload.py. Size: quick-fix. Revisit if: a station's health log
      reports `BUFFER_FULL`.

git mv specs/plans/12-station-upload-retry.md specs/plans/completed/12-station-upload-retry.md

You said you want it before the winter deployment, so it is work and will age toward the 45-day gate. If you would rather treat it as a watch item, I need one concrete signal for it.
